test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Advanced Full Test - 04
subject: general
question:
The question below consists of two statements labelled I and II. You have to decide whether the data provided in the statements are sufficient to answer the question. Read both the statements and give your answer.

Question: Who among the five persons L, M, N, O and P is the fourth richest?

I. Only one person earns more money than M. As many persons earn less than M as many persons earn more than L.

II. O is poorer than N which is poorer than P.

options.text: The information given in statement I alone is sufficient to answer this question.
The information given in statement II alone is sufficient to answer this question.
The information given in either statement I or statement II alone is sufficient to answer this question.
The information given in both statements I and II together is sufficient to answer this question.

solution:
According to the given information:

Five persons: L, M, N, O, and P

Considering Statement I alone:

I. Only one person earns more money than M. As many persons earn less than M as many persons earn more than L.

__ < L < __ < M < __
